description:
One section in full: its kind, summary, novelty and whether it moves (how certain, what kind of motion), its annotation (hit.annotation: how it is laid out and presented, its style tags, the details a designer would point out, each with its kind, a short name for its technique and where it is, and what moves on the live page with the evidence), its screenshot tiles in every size (images.tiles[].sizes: the same tile at smaller widths, px), the text it visibly shows (headings, labels and paragraphs top to bottom, each with its rect and font size), its page as captured (page, and pageSections: every section on it in brief) and sections of the same site's other captured pages (moreFromSite). Use it when you need a section's design details and words, where it sits on its page, or more from its site. It returns no image: view_section shows the section.
Positions are from our capture of the page (page.shotAt, page.viewport, usually 1440×900), not today's live page: y is CSS px from the top of the captured page. geometry.top/height place the section and geometry.left/right are its horizontal crop. images.tiles are its screenshots top to bottom at page.dsf× pixels, each with top/height in section px (0 = the section's top).

search_id.description: Optional: the searchId of the search you got this from, so we learn which results were useful.

name: get_section

hit.description: The section in full: every size of its tiles, and its annotation.

annotation.description: What the annotator wrote about it: layout, presentation, style tags, the details a designer would point out (each with its kind, a short name for its technique and its rect, section CSS px) and what moves on the live page with the evidence the page recorded.

details.description: The details a designer would point out, distinctive ones first as written: kind (layout, framing, linework, diagram, presentation, texture, effects, imagery, typography, color, motion, interaction), name (the technique), text, rect (section CSS px).

name.description: A short name for its technique ("ruler-tick margin rails"), when the annotator gave one.

rect.description: Where it is in the section, section CSS px.

layout.description: How it is laid out, in a line.

motion.description: What moves on the live page. certainty: measured = recorded moving, likely = only a surface that could move. kind: continuous (keeps moving), cycling (swaps on a timer), reveal (animates in once on scroll).

presentation.description: How its content is presented (tabs, a carousel, a marquee, mock product UI), in a line.

contains.description: Roles of notable blocks inside it (a hero holding a logo strip).

geometry.description: The section on its page, page px of our capture (left/right: its horizontal crop; blocks: sub-block boundaries; split: one part of a long section). With include "geometry"; get_section and page_sections give it anyway.

tiles.description: Top to bottom; top/height in section px. With include "tiles"; get_section gives them anyway.

sizes.description: The tile at every width it is stored at, px, smallest first; the last is url. get_section only.

key.description: "page/section"; stable until the page is re-cut.

more.description: Results from this site held back by the per-site cap.

parts.description: Other keys collapsed into this result (parts of one long section, repeats).

text.description: When text was asked for (contains, or a q starting with CONTAINS:): where the section shows it, with the matched characters marked and their rects (section px).

exact.description: true: every phrase as written, inside one heading, label or paragraph; false: all its words, apart.

marks.description: The matched characters of text, as [start, end) pairs.

ocr.description: Read from the pixels (text inside an image), not from the page.

rects.description: Where they are in the section, section CSS px (inside one line of text, approximate).

text.description: The heading, label or paragraph the match is in (a snippet of a long one).

via.description: What found it: look (screenshots), details (annotation meaning), words (keywords), text (the text it visibly shows), and boosts (role, motion, novel). The keys of the contract's match.ranks.

motion.description: Whether it moves on the live page, null when nothing was seen to. certainty: measured = recorded moving, likely = only a surface that could move. kind: continuous (keeps moving), cycling (swaps on a timer), reveal (animates in once on scroll).

novelty.description: How unusual against typical sections of its role: 1 template … 5 experimental.

page.description: The page it is on: id, url, title and kind; with include "page" (and in get_section), also host, height, shotAt, viewport, dsf and innerScroller.

moreFromSite.description: Sections of the same site on its other captured pages.

key.description: "page/section"; stable until the page is re-cut.

pageSections.description: Every section of the page, top to bottom (the section in its page).

key.description: "page/section"; stable until the page is re-cut.

text.description: What the section visibly says, block by block, top to bottom (empty when it was not read).

title: One section in full
